abstract: Covers vCard Format Specification. RFC 6350 vCard Format Specification is current; RFC 7095 jCard: The JSON Format for vCard is current; RFC 9553 JSContact: A JSON Representation of Contact Data is current. Requirements are quotes from the pinned text. SKILL.md holds the workflow; references split versions and the quoted requirements.
